title: Add new release repositories: better_launch
author: ndahn
body:
* Name of the release team: better_launch

* Release repositories to add:
  <!--
  Before release repositories are created, repositories and packages should be submitted to the official rosdistro repository https://github.com/ros/rosdistro for naming review.
  The ros/rosdistro source entry link must be included for each repository.
  Guidelines for package naming are describe in REP-144: https://www.ros.org/reps/rep-0144.html

  If there are any existing release repositories which should have their contents imported into the ros2-gbp organization, list and link to them here.
  Leave the checkbox _unchecked_. The ros2-gbp administrator will check the box when they have completed the repository import.
  -->
  * [better_launch](https://github.com/dfki-ric/better_launch)
    * [rosdistro/humble](https://github.com/ndahn/rosdistro/blob/a2f12e218353218d13b33cc3edcf05f62b1197de/humble/distribution.yaml#L1165)
    * [rosdistro/jazzy](https://github.com/ndahn/rosdistro/blob/a2f12e218353218d13b33cc3edcf05f62b1197de/jazzy/distribution.yaml#L949)
    * [rosdistro/kilted](https://github.com/ndahn/rosdistro/blob/a2f12e218353218d13b33cc3edcf05f62b1197de/kilted/distribution.yaml#L799)
    * [rosdistro/rolling](https://github.com/ndahn/rosdistro/blob/a2f12e218353218d13b33cc3edcf05f62b1197de/rolling/distribution.yaml#L864)
